description: Postes informatiques en libre-service pour les agents de la Ville et de la Métropole de Rennes is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Cette couche d'entités ponctuelle localise les postes informatiques mis à disposition dans des locaux de la Ville de Rennes ou de Rennes Métropole à destination des agents territoriaux des ces deux collectivités ne disposant pas de matériel informatique attitré, dans le but de consulter et de s'informer sur les différents outils informatiques internes de Rennes ... Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Citoyenneté. Its keywords are administration, compétence administrative. The portal shows 105 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-10-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
